snippet.title: Floor Plan: Hands-On Edition - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Floor Plan is a puzzle adventure game that takes place entirely inside an elevator. Go floor to floor, find items, and meet a bizarre cast of characters. Discover relationships between different things in the building and unlock its secrets... all from the comfort of your elevator.

Now remastered and optimized for motion controls! Hands-On Edition is now available on Steam and Oculus Rift.

Official Selection - IndieCade Showcase @ E3 2016

"Buy this and play it – it doesn’t matter which platform." - UploadVR

More about Turbo Button:
http://www.turbo-button.com/

Get Floor Plan on Oculus Store:
https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1106538986077576/

Get Floor Plan on Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/673060/Floor_Plan_HandsOn_Edition/
